repos.name: beeper-message-sync
repos.description: A macOS command-line tool that syncs your Beeper chat history to local JSONL files, downloading attachments and organizing messages by network, chat, and date for backup, search, or LLM use.

repos.name: engineering-notebook
repos.description: A Bun CLI that ingests Claude Code and Codex session transcripts, generates LLM-powered daily summaries, and serves a browsable web UI for your engineering journal.

repos.name: sprout
repos.description: Experimental self-improving multi-agent coding system: a root agent recursively decomposes goals and delegates to specialist subagents, learning from failures by mutating a git-backed agent genome. Supports Claude, GPT, and Gemini.
